mapper.sql: coupon_id, shop_id, name, type, `value`, min_amount, total_qty, issued_qty, start_at, end_at, status, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coupon ( coupon_id, shop_id, name, type, `value`, min_amount, total_qty, issued_qty, start_at, end_at, status, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{couponId}, #{shopId}, #{name}, #{type}, #{value}, #{minAmount}, #{totalQty}, 0, #{startAt}, #{endAt}, 'ACTIVE', #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM coupon WHERE coupon_id = #{couponId} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT FROM coupon WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND issued_qty < total_qty AND start_at <= #{now} AND end_at >= #{now} ORDER BY end_at ASC, coupon_id ASC
SELECT FROM coupon WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC, coupon_id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coupon WHERE is_deleted = 0
